analysis.title: JPM TECH SKETCH: GOOGL New TPUs (re: NVDA, AVGO), RDDT Bad October, DDOG CEO/CFO Takeaways, Internet FAQ, DKNG D/G to Neutral
key_insights: Google is releasing two new TPU variants, bringing its lineup to four TPU offerings. They target confidential computing and wider information access for AI agents. Google once released a new AI processor every two years and put out two at the same time this year.

JPM keeps elevated 2027 data center buildout expectations after the midterms. It believes much of next year's spending is already committed in GPUs, signed power deals and shells under construction or permitted.
JPM models hyperscaler capex growth of about 87% to $1.7T in 2027 and +19% to $2.0T in 2028.

Data center moratorium fears are elevated and policy may be in flux. JPM expects hyperscalers to make contingencies across states and geographies and says building could become more difficult and expensive.

JPM does not believe Google Search is structurally broken but sees AI monetization headwinds. Search growth slowed from 19% in 1Q and 17% in 2Q to 12% in 3Q, despite the fastest query growth in five years.

Google management named FX as the single largest driver of the Search deceleration. Other factors were the Asia retailer impact from the EU de minimis exemption and a media/entertainment pullback after the World Cup.

Google paid clicks rose 8% and CPC rose 4% in 3Q. The concern is that paid click growth slows as AI Mode becomes a bigger share of searches. JPM expects monetization to improve as international AI Mode ads and US multi-turn formats expand.

DDOG management said core business acceleration is broad-based, driven by sales capacity expansion, platform consolidation, broader product adoption and market share gains. Non-AI customer revenue growth accelerated in F3Q.
DDOG typically adds about 2K gross new logos per quarter. Moderating customer additions reflect small customer fluctuations, expanded credits and startup credits.
DDOG's F3Q revenue beat of about $47M versus the $1.14B guidance midpoint was split roughly 60/40 between the core business and its largest customer.

DDOG's F4Q guide assumes only the largest customer's minimum contractual commitment, a sequential headwind because that customer consumed well above the minimum in F3Q. For 2027 DDOG will keep modeling that customer at contractual minimums until the current contract expires.

META is expanding AI-based teen age detection on Instagram globally and rolling it out on Facebook, with Threads later this year. The desk flags that Family DAPs could fail to increase in some quarter.
TSLA is expanding its robotaxi service to San Antonio starting Monday at 5 a.m. local time. No details were given on hours, vehicle type or safety monitors.

Other JPM research headlines: DKNG downgrade to Neutral, IREN positive pricing but development pace warrants caution, VSAT top mid-cap pick, MELI price target cut on tough near- and long-term outlook.
